blocks.html: We handle both the sourcing of a replacement Land Rover engine and its professional installation. This gives you a single point of responsibility for the entire job — you don't need to source an engine yourself and then find a workshop willing to fit a customer-supplied unit.

sections.heading: Our Land Rover Engine Supply & Fit Process

steps.title: Specification & Sourcing
steps.body: We identify the exact replacement engine required using your registration, VIN, model year and engine code. The engine is sourced from vetted UK suppliers.

steps.title: Inspection & Preparation
steps.body: The replacement engine is inspected on arrival for correct specification and condition. Ancillary components are transferred, and new seals, gaskets and timing components are fitted.

steps.title: Removal
steps.body: Your existing engine is professionally removed. All fluids are drained, connections are carefully disconnected, and the engine is lifted out.

steps.title: Installation
steps.body: The replacement engine is fitted, engine mounts are torqued to specification, and the transmission is reconnected. All electrical, fuel, cooling and exhaust connections are remade.

steps.title: Testing & Handover
steps.body: We carry out a full diagnostic scan, leak check, road test and valet before handover.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions — Land Rover Engine Supply & Fit

items.q: How do you determine the correct replacement engine for my Land Rover?
items.a: We use your registration and VIN to confirm the exact engine code, power output and emissions standard fitted to your vehicle from the factory. This ensures the replacement engine is a direct match.

items.q: Where do you source the replacement engines from?
items.a: We source replacement engines from vetted UK suppliers who provide warranty cover. Every engine is inspected on arrival at our workshop for specification, condition and correct fitment points.

No — we supply and fit the replacement engine ourselves. This gives you a single point of responsibility and ensures the engine specification has been correctly matched to your vehicle. We don't fit engines supplied by the customer.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on a supplied and fitted engine?
items.a: We offer a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering both the supplied engine and our installation work. Full warranty terms are available on request.

items.q: How long does the supply and fit process take?
items.a: The typical turnaround is 1–2 weeks from vehicle arrival, but this depends on sourcing time for the correct replacement engine. We'll give you a realistic timescale when we quote.

items.q: Can you recover my Land Rover to your workshop?
items.a: Yes — we offer nationwide recovery from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.
